overview: The big stories are Jensen Huang saying he would return as Nvidia CEO if the board asks, and OpenAI releasing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to mixed reviews. Google made Gemini Tasks free in six countries, Peter Thiel's 13F shows a rotation from utilities into chips, and Tesla unveiled a solid-state transformer for data centers. Your interests file is still the blank template, so this brief is ranked for general tech, AI and investing relevance.

top_items.title: Jensen Huang - Admits 'serious mistakes', will cooperate with Nvidia board probe, and says he'd return as CEO if the board decides it
Sam Altman - OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra, pitched as token-efficient, with Sol ultrafast expanded to Pro 200 plans
Sundar Pichai - Gemini Tasks goes free in six countries on Gemini 4 Hydrogen; it can call businesses for quotes and pay via Google Pay
burrytracker - Peter Thiel's Q3 13F shows exits from 5 energy and utility stocks and $161M put into chips via SOXX, plus a new MSFT stake
Elon Musk - Tesla unveils Powercore, a 7.4 MW solid-state medium-voltage transformer, made in America and operating in 2027
Mustafa Suleyman - Microsoft announces MAI Cyber 2 Flash; its earlier model sent 99 human-checked bug reports to open-source maintainers
Palmer Luckey - Reveals SLAB, a seastead he started after the Oculus sale, raised at a $1B valuation in 2017 and now being topped up
Brian Armstrong - Coinbase is building payment rails and a marketplace where AI agents find, hire and pay one another
